brief_summary: This is a clinical study to determine the safety and efficacy of an investigational drug in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus.
brief_title: MK0431 Monotherapy Study in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (0431-040)

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients have Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus and have laboratory results that are within the values established by the study such as an Hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) \>=7.5% and \<=11% and a Fasting Plasma Glucose (FPG) \>=130 mg/dL and \<=280 mg/dL

Exclusion Criteria :

* Patients have Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus or required insulin therapy within the past 12 months

official_title: A Multicenter, Double-Blind, Randomized, Placebo-Controlled Study of MK0431 in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus Who Have Inadequate Glycemic Control

primary_outcomes.measure: Change From Baseline in Hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) at Week 18
